target_customer: Developer tool companies seeking go-to-market leads (aggregator description)
problem: Dev tool companies struggle to find the users inside target accounts who would champion their product. Ecliptor is described by directories as an AI go-to-market platform that finds such product champions.

founders.name: Andre Fu
founders.background_notes: YC page says he did deep learning research at Toronto with four papers at CVPR, ICCV and NeurIPS.

technical_complexity.rationale: Embedding-based matching of people and accounts is standard ML work for a team with Twitch recommendation experience, with data sourcing as the harder part.

defensibility.rationale: Lead and signal tools are easy to copy and the founders' public product is only a coming-soon page.

market_need_then: Dev tool companies spend on bottom-up product-led sales and lead generation, but no direct demand evidence for Ecliptor was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses ecliptor.ai, an .ai domain; the site showed only a coming soon page.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material found; searches returned similar names like Eclipse and Eclipsor.

outcome_analysis: Ecliptor is a two person YC Winter 2024 team with ML backgrounds from Twitch. Its public footprint is a coming-soon site and aggregator entries, so there is no evidence of traction, later funding or shutdown. The outcome is unclear.
notes: Two aggregators (CB Insights and VCBacked) report about 500K USD from Y Combinator, as a convertible note dated January 2024 or a pre-seed announced April 2024; they disagree and neither is primary, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitor list empty: no dated source found near the batch. No outcome news found. Completeness pass: the 500K (Y Combinator, CB Insights convertible note dated 2024-01-01) rests on databases only; VCBacked and Extruct label it a pre-seed dated April 2024, so type and date conflict; no press confirms.
